杀王降临！（杀王降临！（第22页）“你再施展一下《凌波幻步》试试！”叶凡爬起来，施展凌波幻步。不可思议的一幕出现了！他的身影，宛若鬼魅一样冲出去，比之前快了十倍不止。“我的速度，翻倍了！”叶凡惊讶无比！“之前我的速度，武尊到了我身前，我才能动用《龙血霸体诀》无敌五秒，用炎黄剑斩杀！”“现在《凌波幻步》速度翻倍，岂不是可以主动出击了？”叶凡心中激动。从被动防守。到主动出击。这是质变。叶凡激动的问：“师父，按照我现在的速度，武尊在我多少米的范围内，我可以一击斩杀？”叶弑天回答：“若是一般武尊非常警惕，十米之内，应该可以斩杀。”“若是没有防备之心，大约十五米之内！”听完此话，叶凡心中大喜。离开混沌空间后，距离中州的商会大比，只剩下三天。他要连夜赶回神城，否则来不及！和沈虹、沈慕戎二人辞行，二人头也不抬，抱着手里的武技眼睛一眨不眨的看着：“小凡！一路小心才是，戎儿，你觉得这里是不是应该这么理解？”“内力走任督二脉！然后，进入冲池穴、再从丹田轮回？”沈慕戎摇了摇头：“娘，我觉得不应该这么理解……小弟，刚才你说到哪儿了？”看着二人如此沉迷。叶凡无奈的摇了摇头。不止是二人，王府的其他人，俨然成了一个个武痴！大家都知道，只有提升实力，才能自保！才能跟得上叶凡的脚步。演武场上，牛二带着一群王府老兵，疯狂修炼《霸道刀法》！杀伐之气不绝！叶凡路过的时候，都感觉脸上生疼。最后。叶凡来到唐妙衣的住处，刚要敲门，里面传来声音：“妙衣姐，这个连环扣我解开了！一共九连环，不难啊！”“咦？才有用了一炷香的时间，你就解开了九连环？”唐妙衣美眸惊讶。叶凡推门而入。“谁啊？”叶凡咧嘴一笑：“这不是雪嫣妹妹吗？”许久不见，纳兰雪嫣越发的亭亭玉立，光彩照人。前世叶凡小时候，还经常和纳兰雪嫣一起玩！后来他长大了，开始有了男女意识，便留恋青楼，勾栏听曲，对这个跟屁虫小妹妹没什么性趣。纳兰雪嫣便从他的世界里淡出。“咦~~~”纳兰雪嫣起身，有些嫌弃，直接躲在唐妙衣的身后。唐妙衣的母亲，是纳兰家族的人，二人是表姐妹关系。唐妙衣一笑：“你看看你，纨绔深入人心，都吓到雪嫣了。”叶凡嘴角抽动：“我又不会吃了她，怕什么？”“对了，你刚才说什么九连环呢？”唐妙衣这才扫了一眼桌面的连环扣：“九连环，一共九个铁环相扣！只有一种办法可以解开，此物极其费心费神。”“我当年第一次玩的时候，也花了半个时辰才解开。”“雪嫣天赋很高，居然只用一炷香的时间就解开了！”叶凡惊讶：“真的假的？”“你是七窍玲珑心，所以专注力远超常人，难道雪嫣妹妹也是七窍玲珑心？”目光一转，落在纳兰雪嫣身上。“雪嫣妹妹过来，我来给你检查身体！”

The killing king is coming! (The Killing King is Coming! (Page 22) "Try using "Lingbo Magic Step" again!" Ye Fan got up and used Lingbo Magic Step. An incredible scene appeared! His figure rushed out like a ghost , more than ten times faster than before. "My speed has doubled!" Ye Fan was extremely surprised! "My speed before, when Wu Zun was in front of me, I could use the "Dragon Blood Tyrant Body Technique" to be invincible for five seconds and kill with the Yanhuang Sword. "Now that the speed of "Lingbo Fantasy Step" has doubled, can I take the initiative?" Ye Fan was excited. From passive defense to active attack. This is a qualitative change. Ye Fan asked excitedly: "Master, according to my current speed, how many meters can I kill with one strike?" Ye Shitian replied: "If the general warrior is very vigilant, he should be able to kill within ten meters." Within fifteen meters!" After hearing this, Ye Fan was overjoyed. After leaving the Chaos Space, there were only three days left before the Chamber of Commerce Competition in Zhongzhou. He had to rush back to the Divine City overnight, otherwise it would be too late! He and Shen Hong and Shen Murong After saying goodbye, the two of them didn't even raise their heads. They held the martial arts in their hands and looked at it without blinking: "Xiao Fan! Just be careful along the way, Rong'er, do you think this should be understood this way?" "The inner force goes to the second channel of Ren and Du! Then , enter the Chongchi point, and then reincarnate from the Dantian?" Shen Murong shook his head: "Mom, I don't think you should understand it this way...Little brother, where did you say just now?" Seeing the two of them so obsessed. Ye Fan shook his head helplessly. Not only the two of them, but other people in the palace have become martial arts idiots! Everyone knows that only by improving their strength can they keep up with Ye Fan's footsteps. On the martial arts field, Niu Er led a group of seniors from the palace. Bing, practicing "Domineering Sword Technique" wildly! Ye Fan felt pain on his face when he passed by. Finally, Ye Fan came to Tang Miaoyi's residence and was about to knock on the door when a voice came from inside. I have unlocked this chain! There are nine chains in total, it’s not difficult!” “Huh? It only took a stick of incense to untie the nine chains?” Tang Miaoyi’s beautiful eyes opened. “Who is it?” He smiled and said, "Isn't this sister Xueyan?" After not seeing each other for a long time, Nalan Xueyan became more and more graceful and radiant. In his previous life, Ye Fan often played with Nalan Xueyan when he was a child. Later, when he grew up, he started to have feelings for her! Since he was aware of men and women, he was nostalgic for the brothel and listened to music. He had no sexual interest in this follower little sister. "Hey~~~" Nalan Xueyan stood up, feeling disgusted and hid in Tang Dynasty. Behind Miaoyi. Tang Miaoyi's mother is from the Nalan family, and the two are cousins. Tang Miaoyi smiled: "Look at you, you are so dandy that it scares Xue Yan." Ye Fan's mouth twitched: "I'm afraid again. You won't eat her, so what are you afraid of?" "By the way, what were you talking about?" Tang Miaoyi glanced at the chain link on the table: "There are nine iron rings in total that can be untied. This thing is extremely labor-intensive. "When I played it for the first time, it took me half an hour to solve it." "Xue Yan is very talented, and she actually solved it in just one stick of incense." Ye Fan was surprised: "It's really fake. "You are a Qiqiao Exquisite Heart, so your concentration is far beyond ordinary people. Could it be that Sister Xueyan also has a Qiqiao Exquisite Heart?" His eyes turned and fell on Nalan Xueyan. "Sister Xueyan, come here, let me check your body!"
